author: GamingBolt
description:
Well, College Football 27 is finally in the hands of a section of its wider player base, and there’s a lot of good news coming its way. But can those early impressions truly capture the scale of its ambition, and the quality of its moment-to-moment gameplay? 

Probably not, but they are useful in determining whether this one’s additions have changed things where it matters, a sentiment that is a common undercurrent of most impressions. Of course, there’s nuance involved, and we’ve enjoyed diving into the intricacies here. Join us as we take a look at what to expect for a release that’s been on our minds for a long time now, and has us quite invested in its prospects.
title: Why EA SPORTS College Football 27 Is Suddenly Looking Like a Bigger Deal Than Expected

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's official: PlayStation has returned to social media. Well, not the official Twitter account, but rather PlayStation Support US. After the company announced that it would no longer manufacture physical game discs after January 2028, the main account has effectively become a ghost town. 

No tweets, nothing. A peek at the support profile, which last told players that the PS5 Pro could enhance image quality on PS4 games and how it and the base console could capture gameplay, reveals exactly why.
title: PlayStation Isn’t Just Killing Discs - It Wants to Control the Digital Future
